thread:
sara: Heads up team — tiny EU canary scheduled Mon 08:15 UTC. Need a 1-sentence RN + internal announce. Model pin v6.0.0-opt, fallback v5.9.3. Who can write? @eli @harper
eli: I can. Keep it super short (<35 words). What are the hard gates?
harper: Hard gates: 1) error rate >0.6% sustained for 4m -> rollback; 2) p95 >160ms for 5m -> pause and investigate. Rollback steps: immediate pin to v5.9.3, scale down new lanes, alert #incidents and oncall.
ops-bot: Preflight check: smoke tests present, alerting hooks ok, dashboard: https://grafana.company/redwood/eu-canary-mini. Rate limit and quota validated.
deploy-bot: queued by @sara (job id db-60007). Command:
```
/deploy canary --model v6.0.0-opt --region eu --window 20m --notify #eng-oncall
```
sara: tagging @oncall-ryan for handoff. Embargo until 09:30 UTC. Need owner for first 40m.
oncall-ryan: Ill own 08:15-10:00 UTC. Will run smoke at T+3 and T+12, monitor p95 and errors.
eli: Draft blurb:
"INTERNAL: EU micro-canary v6.0.0-opt — Mon 08:15 UTC. Owner: @oncall-ryan. Fallback: v5.9.3. Targets: p95 <140ms, errors <0.45%. Embargo until 09:30 UTC. On breach -> immediate pin & rollback. Dashboard: https://grafana.company/redwood/eu-canary-mini"
harper: tiny edits: change p95 target to <150ms and note deploy-bot will auto-pause if p95 >200ms. Also call out smoke repo: https://git.company/redwood/evals/eu-mini-smoke
sara: looks good. approvals?
eli: +1 :thumbsup:
harper: +1
sara: I'll pin this in #eng-releases 10m prior and paste in #internal-announce. deploy-bot set to ready?
deploy-bot: job db-60007 status -> ready. Will emit start/complete events and auto-pause on configured thresholds. :robot_face:
ops-bot: If rollback occurs, follow quick runbook: https://runbook.company/redwood/rollback-quick and create incident stub in #incidents with tag "eu-canary-mini". Notify compliance if needed.
oncall-ryan: I'll take action on alerts and file a short post-check if we hit soft thresholds.
sara: perfect — final copy below for posting 10m out:
"INTERNAL: EU micro-canary v6.0.0-opt — Mon 08:15 UTC. Owner: @oncall-ryan. Fallback v5.9.3. Targets: p95 <150ms, errors <0.45%. Embargo until 09:30 UTC. Breach -> immediate pin & rollback. Dashboard: https://grafana.company/redwood/eu-canary-mini"
eli: I'll queue it in the draft channel and set a pin reminder. Closing thread, thanks all. :rocket:
